## What is a knowledge graph?

::: {.def}
[Knowledge graph]{.def-term}
Facts stored as things (nodes) and the relationships between them (edges), so they can be organized and queried exactly.
:::

[[TBD: a small real fragment from your graph.]]{.tbd}

## What is a vector database?

::: {.defs}
::: {.def}
[Embedding]{.def-term}
A passage of text turned into a list of numbers: a point in space, placed near passages with similar meaning.
:::

::: {.def}
[Cosine similarity]{.def-term}
How close two of those points are in direction. A search returns the passages nearest the question.
:::
:::

[[TBD, animated: passages become points; a question finds its nearest neighbours.]]{.tbd}

## What is GraphRAG?

::: {.def}
[RAG: retrieval-augmented generation]{.def-term}
Find relevant material first, then give it to a language model to answer from. GraphRAG retrieves from a knowledge graph as well as the text.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="flow">
  <div class="node"><b>Question</b><span>[TBD: example]</span></div>
  <div class="arrow">→</div>
  <div class="node blue"><b>Retrieve</b><span>from the graph and the text</span></div>
  <div class="arrow">→</div>
  <div class="node blue"><b>Model reads</b><span>only what was retrieved</span></div>
  <div class="arrow">→</div>
  <div class="node"><b>Answer</b><span>with sources</span></div>
</div>
```

## What changed: agentic search

::: {.defs}
::: {.def}
[Agent]{.def-term}
A model that works in steps: it uses tools, reads the results, and decides what to do next.
:::

::: {.def}
[MCP: Model Context Protocol]{.def-term}
A standard way to give a model tools, such as a search box or a database.
:::
:::
